_why: ONE TABLE, TWO READERS. gate.py runs the checks in the cloud and check.js
runs them here, and both must agree about which check a change can break.
Written twice they drift, and the one that drifts is the one that stops
running - so it is written once, here, and consistency.js fails if it stops
covering every harness gate.py runs or push.py sends.
`reaches` is what a check can be broken BY. MadGolf's index.html has no
engine/screens split (Bottlefolio's has), so a change to it is one kind,
ALWAYS means run it whatever changed: the cheap structural ones.
`secs` was measured on BZ's PC on 2026-10-03.
NO RULES CHECK YET (2026-10-03). rulestest.js and rules.js deploy wait on a
MadGolf admin key, which BZ makes; until then firebase-rules.json is not in
the repo and the live rules are managed in the console. Open item in CLAUDE.md.

kinds.app: index.html, live.html, score.html, rsvp.html, manifest.json, logo.webp
kinds.harness: a check's own file - it runs itself

checks.name: audit
checks.note: the named lock matches index.html, versions agree, changelog filled in

checks.name: layout
checks.note: every screen at 390px: headers centered, no button label on two lines, no button row spilling (BZ, 2026-10-04)
